description: Public discussion and issue triage classification reference cases

classifications.symptom: User reports HUD overlay captures mouse clicks instead of passing through on Wayland Linux
classifications.responseGuidance: Explain that Wayland compositor protocols do not expose input-shape manipulation to GTK windows. Click-through works on Windows, macOS, and Linux X11.

classifications.symptom: Install-VolumeControl.ps1 execution blocked by default PowerShell ExecutionPolicy
classifications.responseGuidance: Direct user to run with `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File Install-VolumeControl.ps1` or use the NSIS setup installer.

classifications.symptom: Global hotkey registration fails on Windows due to another running application
classifications.responseGuidance: Check logs for RegisterHotKey error code 1409 (ERROR_HOTKEY_ALREADY_REGISTERED). Advise modifying hotkey configuration in SettingsSurface.

classifications.symptom: winget install dt418.VolumeControl returns 404 or package not found
classifications.responseGuidance: Inform user that Winget package submission is queued; WINGET_LIVE is currently false on the landing page. Direct to GitHub Releases installer.
